data.title: GitHub - Modanez/HomeMinerProxy: Stratum proxy + dashboard for home solo Bitcoin mining (Bitaxe, NerdMiner, ESP32, cpuminer). Every share's difficulty in real time, records with confetti and siren, pool failover, luck meter. Zero dependencies, runs on a Raspberry Pi or Odroid.
